category_title: Grade 1 students who struggle with writing and self-regulation but benefit from oral discourse
scenario_title: Independent writing task leading to copying peers
minimal_context: Joshua is working independently at his desk to write down his findings from a mass measurement activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that you and your partner finished the mass measurement activity, please work independently to write down your findings on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the blank paper and puts his pencil down) I don't know what to put down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just think about what you measured and write it down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans over his desk to look at the student sitting next to him) What did you write for the blocks?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joshua, please focus on your own paper and do your own work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quickly scribbles down letters from his neighbor's paper, copying the words incorrectly) I'm just putting what he has.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Now that you and your partner finished the mass measurement activity, please work independently to write down your findings on your paper.

STUDENT: (Stares at the blank paper and puts his pencil down) I don't know what to put down.

TUTOR: Just think about what you measured and write it down.

STUDENT: (Leans over his desk to look at the student sitting next to him) What did you write for the blocks?

TUTOR: Joshua, please focus on your own paper and do your own work.

STUDENT: (Quickly scribbles down letters from his neighbor's paper, copying the words incorrectly) I'm just putting what he has.

task.content: Independent recording/writing task to record findings from a mass measurement activity.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: He was unsure about his own recording and had difficulty with writing.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He relied on others, often resorting to copying his classmates. In doing so, he often made mistakes recording what others had written.

behavior_patterns.condition: Instead of trying to grapple with the reasoning of the problem
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Writing was a stumbling block for him
